comparison.objective: Lock a multipoint door by lifting its handle before turning a key, versus tune and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered handle actuation and key rotation versus hex-key alignment, setscrew release, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and bounded relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Door reaches locked state only after the required sequence versus repeated safe stops plus post-lock drift resistance.
comparison.reason: Ordered unlocking/rotation is a generic shared primitive; the candidate adds dynamic tuning and measured setting retention. Body/spec details are absent.
